frontmatter.title: Lean Six Sigma for Software Architecture: Preventing Complexity as a Defect
frontmatter.subheading: Use CTQs, root-cause analysis, and design controls to keep architectures evolvable and low-waste.
frontmatter.excerpt: Discover how Lean Six Sigma can improve software architecture by defining quality attributes as CTQs, finding root causes of complexity, and adding lightweight controls to prevent design drift.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
